description.value: Rewilding Roses is a small Roberts Creek operation combining a farm stand with a line of grass-fed tallow skincare products, organic meat, and handcrafted goods. The producer appears at the Sechelt Farmers Market and operates a roadside farm stand at their Joe Road property. The business accepts Bitcoin and Lightning Network payments, which is unusual for a rural farm stand.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a farm shop (shop=farm, organic=only, cuisine=meat) with a farm stand at 906 Joe Road, Roberts Creek. The linked Instagram account (@rewildingroses) reveals the business is primarily 'ReWilding Roses Tallow Skincare' — a health/beauty brand selling tallow-based skincare products — though the Instagram also mentions 'Meat sticks' among products sold at the Sechelt Farmers Market, consistent with the OSM cuisine=meat and organic=only tags. No website content confirms any cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms, etc.), so all such fields default to null.
concerns: The Instagram account identifies the business primarily as 'ReWilding Roses Tallow Skincare' (health/beauty), not a grocery or farm stand — OSM Groceries categorization may be misleading.
No address or physical location is confirmed by the Instagram website content; the farm stand location is OSM-only.
Products appear to be sold primarily at Sechelt Farmers Market rather than exclusively at the Joe Road farm stand — it is unclear whether the farm stand is reliably stocked and staffed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating business at a physical Roberts Creek address with an active Instagram presence and OSM check date of 2024-08-08; qualifies as a publicly accessible farm stand stop for touring cyclists.

provenance.category_correction_reason: The OSM record categorizes this as a farm shop (Groceries), but the Instagram account identifies the business primarily as a tallow skincare brand (health/beauty). The farm stand and organic meat products (meat sticks) are secondary offerings. Category may be partially inaccurate but is not entirely wrong given the farm stand name and OSM tags.
